name: Scott Franklin
page_title: Scott Franklin's Issue Positions (Political Courage Test)
on_the_ballot: Running, Republican for U.S. House (FL) - District 18

positions.question: Do you support the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade?

evidence.text: "As a defender of the unborn, I would welcome any decision that overturns Roe v. Wade, but the leaking of the Dobbs opinion is an unacceptable effort to undermine our venerable Supreme Court."

"Since Roe vs. Wade was decided 49 years ago, 63 million unborn babies have been deprived of their most basic human right to life. We have a sacred responsibility to protect the lives of the unborn. I will always give a voice to those without one."

"Today’s Supreme Court decision rights a 50 year wrong in defense of life. It’s a victory for all who believe in the sanctity of life and the countless lives that will be saved. I was proud to stand with my colleagues to celebrate this occasion."

positions.question: Do you support increasing defense spending?

evidence.text: "America’s armed forces exist to fight and win wars in defense of our national security interests, not to further political ideologies or social experiments. The #FY24NDAA we passed today authorizes the resources and programs to do just that – nothing more, nothing less."

"At a time of dangerous global instability w/Russia & China, we MUST continue needed investments in our national security. I joined my colleagues on @HASCRepublicans urging @POTUS to include a 5% increase above inflation for defense spending."

"The House just passed a STRONG National Defense Authorization Act that👇 🇺🇸 Increases troop pay and BAH 🇺🇸 Refocuses our military on winning wars, not social programs 🇺🇸 Extends the Pacific Deterrence Initiative to deter threat from China 🇺🇸 Standing up for Israel & our allies"

"The passage of the FY23 National Defense Authorization Act is an insurance policy for our national security. This year, we enhanced our military readiness & lethality by including a number of critical provisions & prevented the spread of the woke agenda."

positions.question: Do you support federal spending as a means of promoting economic growth (e.g. grants, tax incentives)?

evidence.text: Voted in favor of HR 2811 "Limit, Save, Grow Act"

"House Democrats' reckless tax-and-spend policies are damaging the economy. Three major takeaways when reading Friday’s Jobs Report: 🚩Workforce participation is stuck at 1977 levels 🚩Inflation is at levels not seen since the early ‘80s 🚩Widespread supply chain bottlenecks"

"Today @HouseGOP passed the most conservative Interior and Environment budget bill ever: ✅ Slashes wasteful spending & bureaucracy ✅ Rebuilds American energy independence ✅ Reins in the EPA & cuts their budget by 40% ✅ Supports growers & ends burdensome EPA water regulations"
Voted against HR 3684 "Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act"

positions.question: Do you support the federal government increasing funding for affordable housing programs?

evidence.text: Voted against HR 8294 "Transportation, Housing and Urban Development, and Related Agencies Appropriations Act, 2023"

positions.question: Do you support the federal government taking action, beyond those of the Federal Reserve, to alleviate inflation?

evidence.text: "@POTUS is divorced from reality when it comes to the economy. Inflation is costing every American family nearly $384/month. Real wages continue to drop under Biden and House Democrats think new taxes and more spending will solve inflation. They are wrong."

"In @POTUS’s op-ed on how he plans to address his 40-year high inflation, he doubles down on crippling taxes and government spending. This will add inflationary pressure. We must reduce spending and lower taxes to fight inflation."

"Prices on everyday goods have surged at the highest pace in 39 years. Inflation & supply chain disruptions are crushing everyone. House Democrats are delusional if they think radical spending will help our economy. Inflation is a tax on all Americans."
Voted against HR 5376 "Inflation Reduction Act of 2022"

positions.question: Do you support the forgiveness of federal student loan debt?

evidence.text: "Businesses forced by the government to shut down during Covid received PPP loans to keep paying their employees. Students who took out loans for college did so willingly for their own benefit. There’s no comparison. The White House needs to stop lying to the American public"

"Joe Biden's illegal student loan bailout will come at the expense of the vast majority of hardworking taxpayers who do not have student loan debt. It's one more in a long list of attempts to buy votes with "free stuff" and pander to supporters."

"Pres. Biden's illegal student loan bailout will add to runaway inflation and escalate our national debt further. It’s patently unfair to ask hardworking Americans without college debt to pay for it. That’s why I voted to repeal this bailout."
Voted against HR 2547 "Comprehensive Debt Collection Improvement Act"

positions.question: Do you support requiring a government-issued identification in order to vote at the polls?

evidence.text: "Requiring proof of citizenship to register to vote in federal elections shouldn’t be a partisan issue. In Florida, it’s the law. I cosponsored HR 8281, the SAVE Act, to ensure this practice nationwide. Americans MUST trust their elections are secure."
"Requiring proof of citizenship to vote keeps our elections secure. There’s only one real reason Democrats would oppose the SAVE Act: they count on benefiting from illegal immigrants’ votes."
Voted against HR 5746 "Freedom to Vote: John R. Lewis Act"

positions.question: Do you support government funding for the development of renewable energy (e.g. solar, wind, geo-thermal)?

evidence.text: "Liberals continue their assault on American oil & gas producers through overregulation. This drives up energy costs for American families at a time of record inflation. We need policies that promote economic prosperity & energy independence."
"The Biden Administration isn't hiding its intentions: They want to usher in Green New Deal policies by making it even more painful for Americans to afford gas."
"Today I voted for @congbillposey's bipartisan bill to support American solar manufacturers and hold China accountable for breaking our trade laws."
Voted in favor of HR 1 "Lower Energy Costs Act"
"Today I Voted in favor of @congbillposey's bipartisan bill to support American solar manufacturers and hold China accountable for breaking our trade laws."

"If Democrats were serious about lowering energy prices and helping Americans thrive, they would ✔️Streamline the permitting process for new energy projects ✔️Approve pipeline permits ✔️Approve LNG export facilities, so our allies don’t rely on Russia for oil"

"Over the past two years, President Biden prioritized a radical climate agenda that shut down domestic energy, put our national security at risk, and caused record-high gas prices. The solution is clear: unleash American energy independence!"
